title: Pharmacokinetic scale-up: accurate prediction of human pharmacokinetic profiles from animal data
quote: Three methods of interspecies pharmacokinetic scale-up provided accurate simulations

verified_quotes.text: Three methods of interspecies pharmacokinetic scale-up provided accurate simulations

summary: Mouse, rat, monkey and dog parameters were scaled to human; three approaches simulated biexponential IV bolus and infusion profiles.
validation: The abstract reports agreement with human profiles. Full methods, error metrics and calibration/validation separation still require inspection before implementation.
data_availability: Primary abstract checked; reusable raw data not verified.
code_availability: Executable estimation code not verified; an accessible paper is not an executable model.
